headline: Anthropic IPO raises a record $81 billion; Iran widens Gulf attacks; Trump, Xi and Putin meet in China

texas.headline: Hinojosa plans to undo several Abbott orders
texas.summary: Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa said she discussed the border with Trump by phone and will rescind Abbott directives including the state H-1B hiring freeze and the under-21 hemp THC sales ban when she takes office Jan. 19.

texas.headline: Texas schools face record enrollment drop
texas.summary: Public schools are projected to lose more than 135,000 students this year, a 2.5% decline the education commissioner tied mainly to lower birth rates and slower migration, with funding cuts to follow.

texas.headline: Cornyn blocks Trump's pick for a North Texas federal bench
texas.summary: Sen. John Cornyn is withholding his blue slip for nominee Elliot Gaiser, saying he is not from Texas and was not vetted; Sen. Ted Cruz backs the nomination.

texas.headline: More than a third of Texas college students leave without a degree
texas.summary: A study of 900,000 recent Texas graduates found 38% left college within six years without a credential, piling up about $1.1 billion in student debt.

texas.headline: Odessa Republican urges GOP back to kitchen-table issues
texas.summary: State Rep. Brooks Landgraf said Republicans lost ground with rural voters and backed a higher school allotment, ending STAAR and regulated marijuana legalization.

us.headline: Democrats' nine Senate flips are the most in nearly 70 years
us.summary: Mary Peltola's win over Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska gives Democrats a 56-44 Senate majority in January, alongside 42 House pickups so far.

us.headline: House Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker
us.summary: Democrats formally picked Hakeem Jeffries as their speaker nominee ahead of taking the House majority.

us.headline: White House withdraws its FDA commissioner nominee
us.summary: The administration pulled its nomination to lead the Food and Drug Administration.

us.headline: Incoming Oversight Democrat tells 13 Trump allies to preserve records
us.summary: Rep. Robert Garcia warned administration figures to keep records ahead of planned House investigations.

us.headline: Families of D.C. midair collision victims seek more safety rules
us.summary: Relatives of those killed in the collision near Washington pressed for additional aviation safety measures.

us.headline: Musk says he feels foolish after GOP spending fell short
us.summary: Elon Musk expressed regret after his roughly $442 million in Republican campaign spending failed to deliver.

australia.headline: Unemployment jumps to 4.9 per cent
australia.summary: The jobless rate rose from 4.7% in October as employment fell by 43,500, the highest rate since the pandemic recovery, and economists expect the RBA to hold rates.

australia.headline: Albanese to meet Xi on Friday at APEC
australia.summary: The prime minister is preparing for talks with China's president in Shenzhen a day after a three-way Xi, Trump and Putin meeting.

australia.headline: Study finds two-thirds of surveyed migrants underpaid
australia.summary: A Migrant Justice Institute survey of nearly 10,000 migrant workers found most were underpaid and few tried to recover wages, many fearing for their visas.

australia.headline: Elton John urges protection for artists from AI
australia.summary: At the ARIA Awards he called on the government to stop AI using Australian artists' work without permission; acting PM Richard Marles said creatives should be paid.

australia.headline: Big early-voting crowds as Victorian campaign rolls on
australia.summary: More than 211,000 Victorians voted early on day one, Opposition Leader Jess Wilson pledged to prioritise gas exploration, and Family First dropped its Bendigo West candidate.

ai.headline: Anthropic's IPO raises a record $81 billion
ai.summary: Anthropic priced shares at $83, above its range, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion and topping SpaceX's raise; trading begins Thursday on Nasdaq as ANT.

ai.headline: Nvidia's interim CEO addresses staff after Huang's exit
ai.summary: Colette Kress told employees to move forward at her first all-hands meeting since Jensen Huang's departure.

ai.headline: JPMorgan develops AI-agent payments without humans
ai.summary: The bank is working with Hyundai Card on transactions carried out by AI agents.

ai.headline: Push to pass the Defiance Act on AI deepfake porn
ai.summary: Paris Hilton and Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez urged the House to pass the bill targeting sexually explicit AI deepfakes.

tech.headline: Intel lands first outside customer for 18A chips
tech.summary: Intel signed its first external foundry customer for its advanced 18A process.

tech.headline: Nadella calls Outlook outage a perfect storm
tech.summary: Microsoft's CEO described the causes of the recent Outlook outage.

tech.headline: Russian charged with spying on defense tech workers
tech.summary: The Justice Department charged a Russian national with surveilling employees of a large US defense technology company.

world.headline: Iran widens attacks to a US air base in Kuwait
world.summary: Iran targeted Ali Al Salem air base and US-linked sites in Bahrain in apparent retaliation for US strikes on Qeshm Island; both countries reported intercepting the attacks.

world.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin issue peace declaration at China summit
world.summary: The three leaders reached a joint declaration during a rare three-way meeting in China.

world.headline: EU proposes €45 billion more in loans for Ukraine
world.summary: The Commission's plan, backed by joint debt, splits funds between financial aid and weapons through 2027; four member states said they will not take part.

world.headline: Hegseth announces restored US-Venezuela military ties
world.summary: On a visit to Caracas, the defense secretary said the countries will resume joint training and intelligence sharing.

aus-cricket.headline: Duckett century hands England ODI series win in Hobart
aus-cricket.summary: England beat Australia by 97 runs to take the series 2-1, bowling Australia out for 231 after posting 328; Cameron Green left with concussion.

aus-cricket.headline: Test squad naming delayed until after next Shield round
aus-cricket.summary: Selectors will wait on the squad for the first Test against New Zealand in Perth until after the round starting Sunday; Green is not expected to play.

aus-cricket.headline: Bancroft reopens sandpaper scandal
aus-cricket.summary: Cameron Bancroft alleged others in the 2018 team knew about the ball tampering, while captain Pat Cummins stood firm.

warriors.headline: Warriors routed 116-94 in Dallas for fourth straight loss
warriors.summary: Cooper Flagg scored 33 for the Mavericks as Golden State fell to 8-7 and 0-4 on its road trip; Will Richard led the Warriors and Curry is expected to miss at least another week.

warriors.headline: Warriors at Memphis tonight on a back-to-back
warriors.summary: Golden State closes its five-game trip at FedExForum on Thursday, the second night of a back-to-back.
